# Scan Receipts — AI Receipt Scanner for iPhone

> Scan Receipts is a free AI receipt scanner and expense tracker for iPhone from Das Group LLC. Photograph a receipt or say the expense aloud — the app extracts merchant, date, amount, tax, and category in under 2 seconds. All processing is on-device. No account is required. The canonical product page is https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/receipts/.

## Short answer

Scan Receipts is a privacy-first AI receipt scanner and expense tracker for iPhone. Photograph a receipt with your camera, or say the expense aloud, and the app creates an expense record with merchant, date, amount, tax, and category extracted automatically in under 2 seconds. Supports PDF and CSV export for taxes and accountants. All scanning is on-device with no cloud uploads. No account required.

## Key features

- AI-powered OCR receipt scanning — 91% on-device accuracy
- Voice receipt entry — say the expense aloud to create a draft instantly
- Auto-extracts merchant, date, amount, tax, and category in under 2 seconds
- 11 automatic tax expense categories (meals, travel, gas, office, healthcare, and more)
- Batch scan multiple receipts in a single session
- Home screen widget showing monthly spending and top categories
- AI spending insights with smart alerts, patterns, and savings suggestions
- Business trip tracking with per-category totals
- Mileage tracking with customizable rates
- Duplicate receipt detection
- Export to PDF and CSV — tax-ready expense reports
- Multiple currencies supported
- 100% on-device processing — privacy-first, no cloud uploads
- No account required

## Privacy

- All receipt scanning and OCR runs on-device using Apple's Vision framework.
- Receipt photos and extracted financial data are stored locally on the device.
- Scan Receipts does not upload receipt photos or expense data to a cloud server.
- Purchases are processed through Apple.
- Anonymous product analytics do not include receipt content or financial data.
- No account or sign-in is required to scan receipts.

## Pricing

- Free download: 15 receipt scans, 1 PDF export, automatic categorization, basic expense tracking, receipt search
- Scan Receipts Pro monthly: $6.99
- Scan Receipts Pro annual: $39.99 (52% savings vs monthly)
- Scan Receipts Pro lifetime: $99.99 one-time
- Pro unlocks unlimited scans, unlimited exports, AI spending insights, business trip tracking, analytics dashboard
- Subscriptions include a 3-day free trial
- Local App Store prices may vary; purchases processed by Apple

## How to use

1. Download Scan Receipts free from the App Store. No account required.
2. Tap scan and point your iPhone camera at a receipt, or tap voice entry and say the expense aloud.
3. The app extracts merchant, date, amount, tax, and category automatically in under 2 seconds.
4. Receipts auto-sort into tax-friendly expense categories. Adjust if needed.
5. At tax time, export as PDF or CSV and send to your accountant or import into tax software.
